## Summary

Brief description of the change and why it is needed.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds capability)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that alters existing behavior)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] CI / tooling
- [ ] Security-relevant (touches policy, authorization, sandbox, or evidence)

## Changes

- What was changed and where (files / modules).

## How was it tested

- [ ] `pytest tests/ -q` passes locally
- [ ] `ruff check cyberai tests scripts` passes
- [ ] New/updated tests cover the change

For security-relevant changes, name the guarantee that is preserved
(e.g. "unauthorized targets are still hard-denied — see test X").

## Checklist

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or credentials committed
- [ ] No live-target testing performed (lab/simulated only)
- [ ] Docs updated if user-facing behavior changed
